name: iptv-dashboard-android
description: IPTV Dashboard (iptv-org playlists) packaged as an Android app with Capacitor and native ExoPlayer playback

scripts.build:web: npm run build:css && npm run build:vendor
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
